# Search Vocabulary

**Status**: Template
**Last updated**: —
**Generated by**: `/procurement-tools:define-spec`

The search strings for this purchase, grouped by register. Register is what decides
which half of the market a search reaches, so the grouping matters more than the
count.

Companion file `search-terms.txt` holds the same strings bare, one per line, for
pasting straight into a search box.

### Notes

Prose annotations for terms that need more than a cell. This is where notes like
"this one will target more industrial products, expect datasheets and no consumer
reviews" belong.

## Spec-code searches

Standards, designations and codes that can be searched directly and cut through
naming chaos entirely: thread designations, DIN/ISO/ANSI numbers, IP ratings,
connector families, tolerance classes.
